title: RAW UNREVIEWED: uniform first-hit modular word writer without an output bank
summary: Complete invented logical character writer: uniform draws of22fixed increments stop at first nonempty target residue modulo27; group sum reads source SPACE/a-z. Order constrains admissibility without a whole-word bank. Source-free expected-length gate only, no native selection or meaning.

design.bound_to_check: Expected group length at least22 for each source character; not a minimum realized length.
